method: Bounded actual-browser verification (one or two independent numeric workers): all eight identities at both LODs, 66 live/interrupted chains per model at 30Hz; player-01 LOD0 repeated at 120Hz. Each run evaluates every skinned mesh vertex after the controller and IK, with the real classic-script runtime and decoded Draco GLB. Exact served payloads and auditor sources are hashed. No GPU renderer timing is inferred.
limitations: These are 66 representative chains per model, not every possible interruption or variable frame-time pattern.
Production 30Hz and dense 120Hz are separate stateful solver trajectories.

Foot plant accuracy uses the documented bone sole marker; actual all-vertex geometry floor is measured independently. Hand support uses an independently reconstructed immutable anatomical Skin/glove triangle with full Hand/ForeArm skinning. Legacy wrist/marker residuals remain descriptive.
Airborne reach projection and recovery release travel are descriptive metrics and require visual assessment.
No physical medium-phone GPU/FPS measurement is provided.
